depth_control.note: the rMDS is an entropy, so its noise depends on how many fragments a bin holds; this asks whether the depth does the separating

rmds_bins_batch_corrected.note: the study's own correction: a per-bin model on the cfDNA isolation date, the WGS library-preparation date and the collection institute, with the response kept in the model as a covariate that the correction does not remove

published_claim_rmds.definition: the normalized Shannon entropy of the 5' end 4-mer frequencies in 500 kb bins, z-scored across the genome within each sample -- the study's rMDS
published_claim_rmds.note: the study reports 1,080 differentially differential bins at FDR < 0.1 out of the autosome's 500 kb bins; the count here is computed on the deposited fragments with the study's length and MAPQ filters and without the ENCODE blacklist exclusion

published_claim_rmds_batch_corrected.definition: the same per-bin differential on the study's own batch-corrected rMDS: the isolation date, the library-preparation date and the collection institute are modelled out of every bin, and the response is kept in the model
published_claim_rmds_batch_corrected.note: the study reports 1,080 bins differential at FDR < 0.1 out of the autosome's 500 kb bins, and the study's classifier reaches AUC 0.99 in patient-level cross-validation and 0.89 with an institute held out
